notes.title: HURRAY! I got achievements working!
notes.content: I had a lot of trouble getting it to work but I was able to get achievements to work in Crystal's Castle. I almost gave up but after scouring the interwebs for information and looking in the help file for Game Maker Studio, I figured it out. And just in time for my next game which I'm close to releasing for which I also want achievements for.

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content: I'm testing out achievement implementation in Crystal's Castle because my next game is nearly finished and I want achievements in that game as well. I will create more if my code works as intended.

notes.title: Major bug fix
notes.content: I fixed a game breaking bug that would have prevented the game from being completed.
